title: Advertisement for the Post of Multi-Task Worker (Driver cum Peon)

FULL TEXT:
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in Research Project entitled
“Climate, Health and Air Monitoring project (CHAMP)- Communicating, Engaging and Empowering
Communities for Clean Air and Better Health)”. Post is purely on contract basis and co-terminus with the
term period of the project
Post : Multi-Task Worker (Driver cum Peon)(No. of Post: 1)
a) Qualification
 Essential: 10th (Matriculation)
 Desirable: Driving experience (Four Wheeler)
b) Salary: Rs. 20,000/- per month (fixed)
c) Job Description:
 Candidate need to perform duties as trained driver cum Peon, required to do multitask and to
assist in the day to day, project /office work, field visits and other related work as per need of
project time to time.
 Applications along with bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work experience should
reach to the undersigned latest by 17th January 2025 before 4.00 pm in room no 227, 2nd Floor,
Dept of Environment Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh
 The interview date and time will be informed through email/phone to shortlisted eligible
candidates.
 Incomplete form will be rejected.
 No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab
University and/or funding agency will govern the selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Principle Investigator
E-mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
